capabilities: Style full-line inline fields as tags
Convert field names into inner links
Turn field values into links via configurable patterns
Hide configurable fields from the reader view
disambiguation: It does not add a properties editor; it only restyles and links existing Dataview inline fields in the reader view.
extras: The README notes Dataview is not a hard dependency but the features are not very useful without it.
intentEvidence: Adds pretty tag-like styles for full-line inline fields from Dataview
problem: Obsidian lacks the Logseq look where page-level inline fields render as tag-like properties with linked field names.

relations.evidence: Adds pretty tag-like styles for full-line inline fields from Dataview

summary: Styles Dataview inline fields as Logseq-like page properties, turning field names into inner links and values into pattern-based links.
